entities.name: Carlo Camillo II Massimo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Camillo Massimi was an Italian cardinal in 17th century Rome, best remembered as a major patron of Baroque artists such as Poussin, Lorrain, Velázquez, Duquesnoy, Algardi, Francesco Fontana and Cosimo Fancelli.
